chapters.title: 01 / THE FIELD
chapters.question: Where does the internet appear?
chapters.reading: Estimated positions become national totals. These are database assignments, not verified server buildings.
chapters.metric: Estimated IPv4 geography; location counts and national aggregates use different denominators.

chapters.title: 02 / PUBLISHED TERRITORIES
chapters.question: What do providers choose to publish?
chapters.reading: Provider lists describe different scopes. Google Cloud overlaps Google; these totals must not be added together.
chapters.metric: Published IPv4 counts by country / shared logarithmic scale.

chapters.title: 03 / OBSERVED NETWORKS
chapters.question: Who originates the address space?
chapters.reading: One BGP snapshot, four selected primary organizations. Origin registration is not legal ownership.
chapters.metric: Observed IPv4 by country / shared logarithmic scale.

chapters.title: 04 / RELATIVE WEIGHT
chapters.question: How much of a country’s observed space?
chapters.reading: The same national denominator changes the comparison. A high share need not mean a large absolute address count.
